name: nzbget
summary: [Nzbget](http://nzbget.com/) is a usenet downloader, written in C++ and designed with performance in mind to achieve maximum download speed by using very little system resources.

env.name: NZBGET_USER
env.description: Specify the user for web authentication.

env.name: NZBGET_PASS
env.description: Specify the password for web authentication.

docs.setup:
Webui can be found at `<your-ip>:6789` and the default login details (change ASAP) are

`login:nzbget, password:tegbzn6789`

To allow scheduling, from the webui set the time correction value in settings/logging.

You can add an additional mount point for intermediate unpacking folder with:-

`-v /path/to/nzbget/intermediate:/intermediate`

for example, and changing the setting for InterDir in the PATHS tab of settings to `/intermediate`

subfolder.base_url_note: NZBGet answers under any path prefix; nothing to change

changelog.text: Add new dependency for boost filesystem.
Rebase to Alpine 3.21. Move MainDir to /config, leave default DestDir/InterDir as /downloads.
Revive image based on the fork from https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget.
